Assignment Title: AIRPORT BAGGAGE HANDLING SYSTEM

Assignment Question:
Problem Statement

An international airport maintains information about passengers checking in their baggage. Each passenger record contains the Passenger ID, Airline Name and Total Baggage Weight (kg).

Develop a Java program using a Passenger class with private instance variables and a parameterized constructor to initialize all passenger details.

The airport provides a common Free Baggage Allowance (kg) for all passengers. Since this value is common to every passenger, it should be stored as a static variable.

If the total baggage weight exceeds the free baggage allowance, the excess baggage charge is calculated as:

Excess Charge = (Total Baggage Weight − Free Baggage Allowance) × ₹500

Otherwise, the excess charge is ₹0.

In addition to instance methods, implement a static method that updates the free baggage allowance for all passengers.

The program should:

Read the details of 2 passengers.

Set the common free baggage allowance (20 kg) using static block.

Calculate the excess baggage charge for every passenger.

Display the details of both passengers.

Find the passenger paying the highest excess baggage charge and return his/her ID.

Invoke the static method setFreeAllowance() to reset the static variable to 30 kg.

Recalculate the excess baggage charge for every passenger and display their sum.

Input Format

For each of the 2 passengers, read the following details:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Total Baggage Weight (in kg)

Output Format

For each passenger, display:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Excess Baggage Charge

And then display:

Passenger ID who is paying the Highest Excess Baggage Charge

Sum of Updated Excess Baggage Charge of both passengers

Sample Input and Output

Input | Output
101; Air India; 35; 102; IndiGo; 25 | 101; Air India; 7500.00; 102; IndiGo; 2500.00; 101; 2500.00

Read the details of 2 passengers.

Invoke the static method setFreeAllowance() to reset the static variable to 30 kg.

Recalculate the excess baggage charge for every passenger and display their sum.

Input Format

For each of the 2 passengers, read the following details:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Total Baggage Weight (in kg)

Output Format

For each passenger, display:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Excess Baggage Charge

And then display:

Passenger ID who is paying the Highest Excess Baggage Charge

Sum of Updated Excess Baggage Charge of both passengers

Invoke the static method setFreeAllowance() to reset the static variable to 30 kg.

Recalculate the excess baggage charge for every passenger and display their sum.

Input Format

For each of the 2 passengers, read the following details:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Total Baggage Weight (in kg)

Output Format

For each passenger, display:

Passenger ID

Airline Name

Excess Baggage Charge

And then display:

Passenger ID who is paying the Highest Excess Baggage Charge

Sum of Updated Excess Baggage Charge of both passengers

Sample Input and Output

Input | Output
101; Air India; 35; 102; IndiGo; 25 | 101; Air India; 7500.00; 102; IndiGo; 2500.00; 101; 2500.00
